name: Curriculum Sampling Strategy for Structured Supervision
definition: A supervision technique using sparse 2D pixel locations on randomly oriented slice planes to provide structured constraints and spatial coherence, blended with voxel supervision via a curriculum schedule.
summary: Curriculum Sampling Strategy for Structured Supervision blends sparse voxel-based Monte Carlo estimation with planar slice-based constraints to enforce spatial coherence and improve shear-warp rendering fidelity.
